;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Battle of Chinagodrar]]
**[[Islamist]] militants kill over 25 [[Niger Armed Forces|Nigerien soldiers]] in an attack on an [[army base]] in [[Tillabéri Region]], [[Niger]]. 63 militants are also killed in the ensuing [[shootout]]. [https://punchng.com/63-terrorists-25-others-killed-in-niger-army-base-attack/ (''The Punch'')] [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-nigeria-security/suspected-islamists-kill-25-soldiers-in-niger-government-idUSKBN1Z82JN (Reuters)]
*[[Ukraine International Airlines Flight 752]]
**[[United States|U.S.]], [[Canada|Canadian]], [[United Kingdom|British]] and [[Iraq]]i officials say they believe the [[plane crash]] near [[Tehran]] in which 176 were killed yesterday was likely caused accidentally by an [[Iran]]ian [[anti-aircraft weaponry|anti-aircraft missile]], while Iran says it was due to "[[mechanical failure]]". [https://www.newsweek.com/iranians-shot-down-ukraine-flight-mistake-sources-1481313 (''Newsweek'')] [https://www.npr.org/2020/01/09/794863678/we-will-surely-find-out-the-truth-questions-linger-about-jet-crash-in-iran (NPR)] [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-iran-crash-britain/johnson-says-there-is-evidence-ukrainian-plane-was-shot-down-by-iran-missile-idUKKBN1Z82LD?il=0 (Reuters)]
**''[[The New York Times]]'' releases a verified video obtained from an Iranian citizen showing the plane being struck by what appears to be a [[surface-to-air missile]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2020/01/09/video/iran-plane-missile.html (''The New York Times'')]
**In a news conference, [[Prime Minister of Canada|Canadian Prime Minister]] [[Justin Trudeau]] says it's "too early to draw definitive conclusions" that the downing of the plane was an "[[act of war]]". Trudeau also condemns Iran's attack on U.S. bases in Iraq. [https://nationalpost.com/news/canada/champagne-asks-iran-to-let-canadian-officials-in-to-investigate-plane-crash (''National Post'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*A bus crashes in Iran's [[Mazandaran Province]], killing at least 20 passengers and injuring 24 others. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/01/reported-dead-bus-crash-iran-iranian-media-200109053940090.html (Al Jazeera)]

;Law and crime
*Judge Ghassan Ouiedat, a [[Lebanon|Lebanese]] [[prosecutor]], imposes a [[Freedom of movement|travel ban]] on former Chairman of [[Nissan]] [[Carlos Ghosn]] after he was summoned over an [[Interpol]] warrant issued by Japan seeking his arrest on [[financial misconduct]] charges. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-nissan-ghosn-lebanon-questioning/lebanon-imposes-travel-ban-on-ex-nissan-boss-ghosn-judicial-source-idUSKBN1Z80ZC (Reuters)]
*[[Trial of Catalonia independence leaders]]
**The [[Spanish Supreme Court]] revokes the immunity of jailed [[Oriol Junqueras]] declared by the [[European Court of Justice]] in a sentence on 19 December. This happens after the board of [[European Parliament]] recognized the former [[List of vice presidents of Catalonia|Vice President of Catalonia]] as a [[Member of the European Parliament|MEP]] since 3 July and was elected president of the [[Greens–European Free Alliance]] parliamentary group. [https://www.nytimes.com/aponline/2020/01/09/world/europe/ap-eu-spain-catalonia.html (''The New York Times'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[Brexit]]
**The [[House of Commons of the United Kingdom|United Kingdom House of Commons]] votes 330–231 to pass the [[Brexit withdrawal agreement|Withdrawal Agreement Bill]] authorizing the country’s departure from the [[European Union]] at the end of the month. [https://nbc25news.com/news/nation-world/lawmakers-approve-brexit-bill-uk-on-course-for-jan-31-exit (Associated Press)]
